title: Bars
description: Two to six horizontal bars grow to their values with a small overshoot (GSAP CustomEase) and the number at the end of each bar counts with it. One bar is gold.

props.items: required, 2-6 of {label, value, color: 2 or 3 for a content colour}

props.highlight: which bar is gold, counted from 1 (default: the largest)
props.note: one small line under the chart
